description: Deterministically convert Marketing Cloud Next (MCN) Handlebars to AMPscript (best-effort, lossy). Inline helper calls that map back to an AMPscript function become %%=Fn(…)=%%; bare variables {{name}} become %%=v(@name)=%%. Block helpers ({{#each}}/{{#if}}), partials, dotted binding paths, and helpers with no AMPscript equivalent are flagged MANUAL_REWRITE_REQUIRED. Use the convertHandlebarsToAmpscript PROMPT for AI-enhanced handling.

code.description: The MCN Handlebars code to convert to AMPscript.

name: convertHandlebarsToAmpscript
